headline: Black Friday shopping before the lockout: the Cubs land Itoh, Toronto adds Chisholm to Taira, and Suzuki, King and Arozarena are still on the board with four days left.

news.title: Cubs agree with Hiromi Itoh
news.note: Feinsand confirmed it Friday night after Robert Murray broke it; terms aren't out. That's all three big posted NPB players signed: Sato and Itoh to the Cubs, Taira to Toronto. An hour later the Cubs also agreed with lefty swingman Ryan Yarbrough on one year.

news.title: Blue Jays sign Jazz Chisholm Jr.: $34.5 million guaranteed
news.note: One year with a $16M player option for 2028 that turns into a $40M club option if he declines it. Toronto, last in runs and homers in 2026, gets its power bat the same day it announced Taira.

news.title: Diamondbacks add Kona Takahashi on one year, $3 million
news.note: Will Sammon had it. The 29-year-old had a 2.54 ERA in 22 starts for Seibu and will compete for a back-end spot.

news.title: Pirates trade Henry Davis to Arizona for Tim Tawa
news.note: The 2021 No. 1 overall pick goes to the Diamondbacks for a utility player. One of the few young catchers to move this winter.

news.title: Cubs could trade position prospects for pitching
news.note: With Sato in the core, The Athletic's Sharma and Mooney see the Cubs dealing from position-player depth. Six of their top eight prospects are hitters, and Logan Webb is reportedly available.
